title: Indeed company reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one employee review, charged), company (Indeed's own ratings and profile for the employer, free) and status (one per company and country, free).

dataset.title: Indeed company reviews
dataset.description: One row per employee review, plus per-company context and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; company and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
